# system.playHaptic

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Play haptic vibration.

```lua
system.playHaptic(duration[, strength])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` |  | yes | in ms (number) or pattern (string) |
| `strength` | number | optional (default `0`) | % of the max strength, 0 stands for the strength entered in System |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
system.playHaptic(200) -- Bzz during 200ms
system.playHaptic("- . -") -- Bzzz Bz Bzzz
```

## Used in

- [Background alert task](../../cookbook/alert-task.md)

## Real-world usage

<div class="api-usage">Called 4 times across 2 open-source Ethos Lua projects. A few short excerpts:</div>

=== "Example 1"

    ```lua
    local function haptic()
      if system.playHaptic then system.playHaptic(". . . .") end
    end
    ```

=== "Example 2"

    ```lua
    local function show(newText)
      if not newText or newText == "" then return end
      text = newText
      expiresAt = os.clock() + BANNER_SECONDS
      if system and system.playHaptic then system.playHaptic(". . . .") end
    end
    ```
